teaser: "You've got the total before I even ask," someone says at the table, half admiring, half tired of it. You are a life path 8, the Powerhouse, and an ESTJ, the Executive, and that sentence sits close to the center of this crossing. The 8 asks for mastery of money, work, and authority; the ESTJ already runs on order and structure, already keeps the ledger straight without being asked. The two do not balance each other so much as agree completely, a weight carried into an ordinary week without much comment.
